I don't know. August 14, 2026 is after my knowledge cutoff (June 2026), and I have no way to look up live data here. Any number I gave would be invented.

CoinMarketCap, CoinGecko, and Yahoo Finance (BTC-USD) all have historical daily data. Note that crypto trades 24/7, so "closing price" depends on the source's cutoff, which is usually 00:00 UTC. CoinMarketCap and CoinGecko may differ slightly from each other for that reason.
